title: Expose the shard that throttles first
description: Choose a workload, provision shards, and concentrate traffic on one partition key. The model checks both per-shard record and byte limits instead of hiding skew behind a stream-wide average.

workloads.label: Checkout events
workloads.detail: Order-level events use the order ID as the partition key. A flash sale can concentrate traffic on a small set of merchants.

workloads.label: Device telemetry
workloads.detail: Small measurements arrive from many devices. A tenant ID alone is too coarse when one tenant owns a large fleet.

workloads.label: Change data capture
workloads.detail: Larger row-change envelopes make byte throughput fail before the record-rate limit.
